newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Banca Sella cuts prime rate to 8.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Banca Sella cuts prime rate to 8.75 pct.

text.p: Italy Banca Sella said it cut its prime rate to 8.75 percent from 9.50 percent effective today following the Bank of Italy's 75 basis point discount rate cut late on Tuesday.
The bank also said it was cutting its top rate to 16 percent from 16.75 percent.

The Banca Sella is the second Italian bank to cut its prime rate following the Bank of Italy's move earlier this week. Banca Populare di Novara on Thursday cut its prime rate by 75 basis points to 8.75 percent.
The Bank of Italy reduced its discount rate to 6.75 percent from 7.50 percent on Tuesday, and its fixed advances or Lombard rate to 8.25 percent from nine percent.
